'''Armada''' is the 20th expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[Decipher]] on 29 February 2000 and consists of 1 card. This card was inserted into the PC game [http://en.memory-alpha.org/wiki/Star_Trek:_Armada Star Trek: Armada] by Activision as a promotional tie-in. This card is also included in the [[All Good Things]] boxed set for a final release.
